objective: Review the native-process to sidecar-launcher bridge boundary after the accepted direct_launch_handoff_failure run and decide whether a narrow bridge fixture implementation may be attempted without claiming direct Verilator sidecar execution.

review_decision.reason: The definition is narrow enough to review before code changes. It only permits a future fixture to bridge validated native parser metadata, reviewed direct-launch handoff readiness, explicit pulp_ita_mha 64x1 sidecar context, and the existing sidecar launcher entrypoint.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still boundary review, not native-path execution. The Verilator-facing process has not entered the sidecar launcher, run compare, or produced timing evidence. The next implementation must remain fixture-level until a later run proves the authority chain.
accepted_because: the source review accepted direct_launch_handoff_failure as honest evidence
the bridge boundary stays inside existing importable tooling and does not add a public CLI
generated command text, parser success, handoff readiness, separate sidecar execution, reports, and artifacts remain non-authoritative by themselves
the scope remains pulp_ita_mha 64x1 and coverage_output_equivalence
timing, arbitrary filelists, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI changes, raw-state equality, and production throughput remain non-claims

required_next_gate.name: implement_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_sidecar_launcher_bridge_fixture_gate
must_implement: a non-executing fixture that represents validated parser metadata plus handoff readiness being bridge-ready for the existing sidecar launcher
explicit validation that target/template/shape/source context is present before launcher bridge metadata is produced
explicit flags proving the fixture did not execute sidecar stages or compare outputs
preserved failure classes for missing context, authority mismatch, bridge failure, stage failure, compare failure, and timing-without-measurement

non_claims: not broad native Verilator option support
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
